description: One Finnish fiscal year, with its financial statements decoded from the company's PRH XBRL filing: revenue (null = not published, never zero), operating and net result, equity, total assets, debts, plus the prior-year comparatives as published in the same filing (EUR). Closing date comes from list_finnish_company_filings. Paid via x402 ($0.15 in USDC or EURC). FI accounts are served only for a company the live PRH profile serves, as /evenements: a Business ID unknown to the PRH (a sole trader, toiminimi, or a name under objection) gets the profile's 404 (entreprise_inconnue), a company form that does not prove a legal person (branch of a foreign trader) gets forme_juridique_non_servie, a PRH outage gets 503; never billed (rule R1). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_finnish_company_filing

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
